criteria.requirement: Add sqlparse.fingerprint.fingerprint(text,encoding=None,digest=False,replace_constants=True) using real candidate lexer token types. Remove actual comments/whitespace, normalize keyword spelling/spacing and replace numeric/single-quoted/dollar-quoted literals with ?, optionally also NULL/TRUE/FALSE. Preserve identifiers including quoted names, operators, statement boundaries, existing named/positional placeholders and IN-list cardinality. Return deterministic canonical text or SHA256 of it. Do not treat comment markers inside strings as comments, do not connect to databases, and explicitly state this groups token shape rather than proving semantic equivalence or generating safe executable parameterized SQL.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
